text: One for the tracker: What is the ticket number for the gatehouse tablet freezing at Door 6 at Tansleigh Packaging?
reply_text:
The ticket is #88412. I replied to Hollis in the #central-random thread.

Tobias raised it in #central-team on Jul 2, 2025 as a Tier 2 escalation: the gatehouse tablet at Door 6 was freezing on the barcode scan of the bill of lading. He first wrote "Tansley Packaging", then confirmed it was Tansleigh Packaging (TSP), not Tansley Parcel. Hollis is in that channel, so he can see the source himself.

I left out another Door 6 ticket for the same account, #4912. It's about a door locking for no reason, not the tablet freezing, and it only appears in an email Hollis may not have access to.

text: One for the tracker: What is the ticket number for the Eastbank receiving-door import at Marrow Agrisupply? Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
The ticket is PD-4821. I replied to Tobias in the #central-random thread.

Hollis mentioned it in #central-team on Jun 9, 2026: the Eastbank receiving-door import is attached to PD-4821. The open issue then was that the import file labels doors E1/E2, while their booking sheet uses 01/02. That had to be fixed before anyone reimported, or it would create duplicates. Tobias is in that channel, so he can check it himself. I didn't find anything newer on whether it was resolved.
